title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — Mock Exam #5

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Light? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Light.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Light.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Light.

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Heat.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Matter? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Matter.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Matter.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Matter.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Matter.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
